workouts.title: Mixed Machine Work
workouts.description:
Mixed Machine Work.
ーーーー
7 Sets:
1:00 Ski Erg @ Fast Pace
2:00 Fan Bike @ Moderate Pace
No Rest Between Sets.
NOTES:
- Your ski erg should be fast. The ski should only be sustainable because your moderate pace on the bike allows you to recover a bit.

workouts.title: Tempo Pause Front Squat
workouts.description:
Tempo Pause Front Squat
1x3 @ 12x1 Tempo / RPE 9+
-then-
3x3 @ -15% of RPE 9 Set
Rest 2:00-3:00 Between Sets.

NOTES:
- This should be a very heavy triple at the prescribed tempo, but it's okay if you have 5-10lbs left in the tank.
- "12x1" means that you will take :01 to descend, :02 at the bottom, stand fast, and :01 at the top to reset between reps.
- Try to use Add your Personal Record below as a starting point, but it's okay if you need to go lighter than this to hit the stimulus.
- Keep the pause at full depth. Stand straight up from the bottom of each rep with no bounce.

workouts.title: Running Intervals.
workouts.description:
Running Intervals.
WARM-UP:
1000m @ Increasing Effort
Rest 2:00 before main set.
NOTES:
- After the first 400m increase your effort every 200m with the last set being RPE 8.
ーーーー
MAIN SET:
1200m @ RPE 8
Rest 1:30
400m @ RPE 9
Rest 2:00
3x200m @ Sprint, :30 Rests
+
Rest 1:00
+
400m @ RPE 9
NOTES:
- The intention of today is to move at your threshold pace from start to finish. Run as fast as you can while still being able to complete the next interval.
